entries.jp: アナウンス
entries.en: Announcer

entries.jp: 準決勝戦開始
entries.en: Semifinal Begins

entries.jp: ２回戦開始
entries.en: Second Round Begins

entries.jp: {v:0008}もぉ～～！{n}ドジなんだからぁ！
entries.en: {v:0008}Ughhh! You're such a klutz!

entries.jp: {v:0055}ああっ！ルイセちゃんが！{n}もぅっ！敵討ちよ！
entries.en: {v:0055}Oh, no! Luise-chan! Grrr! I'll get them for this!

entries.jp: この俺の攻撃に、どこまで耐えられるかな？
entries.en: Let's see how long you can stand up to my attacks!

entries.jp: く、くそ‥‥。{n}やるじゃねぇか‥‥。
entries.en: D-damn... You're pretty good...

entries.jp: まさか、俺たちが負けるとは‥‥。{n}強えな、お前ら‥‥。
entries.en: Never thought we'd lose... You lot are strong...

entries.jp: やるじゃねぇか‥‥。{n}だが、まだまだだな！
entries.en: Not bad... But you've still got a ways to go!

entries.jp: 後は任せたぜ。{n}俺の分まで、頼む‥‥。
entries.en: The rest is up to you. Fight for me, too...

entries.jp: 任せておけ！{n}後は俺一人で十分だ！
entries.en: Leave it to me! I can handle the rest myself!

entries.jp: くそっ！{n}まだまだ俺は戦えるぞ‥‥。
entries.en: Damn it! I've still got some fight left in me...

entries.jp: それ以上は無理だ、ニック。{n}後は俺に任せて退くんだ。
entries.en: You can't go on, Nick. Fall back and leave the rest{n}to me.

entries.jp: すまない‥‥。
entries.en: Sorry...

entries.jp: お前たち、なかなかやるな。{n}久しぶりに強い奴と戦えて、面白かったぜ‥‥。{n}決勝戦、がんばれよ‥‥。
entries.en: You lot are pretty good. Been a while since I fought{n}anyone strong. That was fun... Good luck in the final...

entries.jp: 後は俺に任せて、お前は下がるんだ。
entries.en: Fall back. Leave the rest to me.

entries.jp: すまない、ニック。
entries.en: Sorry, Nick.

entries.jp: 俺の力、見せてやる！
entries.en: I'll show you what I can do!

entries.jp: お前の力、見せてもらおう。
entries.en: Let's see what you're capable of.

entries.jp: し、しまった‥‥。{n}この傷では、もう無理か‥‥。
entries.en: D-damn... Can't go on with a wound like this...

entries.jp: 勝負あり！{p}なんと、この勝負を制したチームは{n}王都ローザリアの兄妹チーム！{n}見事、準決勝へのキップを手にしました！
entries.en: The match is over!{p}What a result! The winners are the brother-and-sister{n}team from the Royal Capital Rosaria! They've earned{n}their place in the semifinals!

entries.jp: 勝負あり！{p}なんと、この勝負を制したチームは{n}王都ローザリアの兄妹チーム！{p}見事、あのニックを倒し、{n}決勝へのキップを手にしました！
entries.en: The match is over!{p}What a result! The winners are the brother-and-sister{n}team from the Royal Capital Rosaria!{p}They've defeated the mighty Nick and earned their{n}place in the final!
